provenance.citation: Nishiyama, Y.; Langan, P.; Chanzy, H. J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2002, 124, 9074-9082.
provenance.transcribed_from: legacy/cellulose-builder-2013/asy_I_beta, dimensions_I_beta (Gomes & Skaf, J. Comput. Chem. 2012, 33, 1338-1346, DOI: 10.1002/jcc.22959)

symmetry_operations.name: P2_1_screw
symmetry_operations.description: Two-fold screw axis parallel to c. Legacy Cellulose-Builder applies this operation to the full 42-atom asymmetric unit (both the origin and center rings) to generate a second, adjacent unit-cell layer; combined with edge-trimming during replication this reproduces the alternating origin/center sheet stacking reported by Nishiyama et al. It does not itself derive the center ring from the origin ring -- both rings are independently reported experimental positions already present in asymmetric_unit.

asymmetric_unit.description: 42 atoms: 21-atom origin anhydroglucopyranose ring (rows 0-20) followed by the 21-atom center ring (rows 21-41), as reported by Nishiyama et al. and transcribed unchanged from legacy asy_I_beta. atom_labels repeats the same 21-label ring sequence (per legacy atomtypes_I_beta) once for each ring.
